description: GéoGuyane is the shared geographic information platform of French Guiana, the French overseas region in South America, pooling data from State services such as the territorial directorate DGTM and local partners. The home page read on 2026-09-28 offers a map browser to view the data mobilised by the portal and build maps, a map library of ready maps to consult and download, a data catalogue of metadata records describing the available geographic data, geoservices and resources, and a professional area; news items announce the release of the IGN Ortho Express Guyane 2025 imagery through a request form (August 2026), a new database of cycle paths presented by the DGTM in May 2026, and strong growth in use during 2025, alongside maps of protected natural areas. Coverage is French Guiana. Access is free for consultation, with some datasets on request; no licence is stated on the home page. Caveats: the catalogue content was not listed, and infrastructure layers vary in currency. It supports hazard exposure and adaptation studies of roads, settlements and networks along the coast and rivers of French Guiana. No related French Guiana geoportal record is catalogued; the INSEE census dossier complements it.
